objective: Fix BUKLOD Ako Lang post privacy leakage across public and scoped feeds, with secure realtime revocation and stale-cache eviction, without changing media playback or other Wall features.
productionBaselineEvidence: Read-only production Supabase inspection 2026-11-12 identified two permissive alternate SELECT policies and two SECURITY DEFINER feeds exposing author_only posts. Emergency backend-only fixes applied on 2026-11-12, SQL assertions verified non-owner cannot read protected posts while owner and public controls retain access. GitHub main SHA is a source-only baseline, not evidence of deployed Android/OTA.
chosenApproach: Tighten canonical RLS, guard security-definer feed eligibility, send ID-only visibility-revoked Realtime events, evict visible rows and warm caches on existing Wall, Marites and scoped screens.
selectionRationale: Data access must be denied by server immediately; realtime UI eviction supplements backend authorization with minimal client changes without modifying photo/video rendering.
alternativeApproaches: Hide posts only in the client: rejected because SQL and security-definer feed RPCs still leak private data.
Replace existing feed ranking, media and subscription architecture: rejected as too risky for unrelated functional features.
Force global polling on every client: rejected for scalability, battery and performance.
preserveBehaviors: Public posts and their existing ranking, media and reactions remain visible.
Post author can still see their Ako Lang content.
Scoped non-private posts remain visible to active eligible members.
No video player, ads, post creation or profile behavior is modified.
No broad database grants, no RLS bypass, no destructive historical data changes.
acceptanceChecks: Authenticated nonowner sees zero private rows through direct SELECT, post detail, public feed and scoped feed.
Author retains access to own private rows; ordinary public posts remain readable.
Member-scoped Realtime topics require membership and carry no post content.
TypeScript check, Node test contracts and anti-regression scope gate pass on exact PR head.
Consolidated RC and two-account live-device behavior verified before production Expo OTA; no OTA published by this PR.
